courses.title: Complete React 19 & Next.js Architecture Bootcamp
courses.description:
Master Modern React From Fundamentals to Production Scale

Build blazing-fast, resilient web applications using React 19, Tailwind CSS, and server actions. This course covers everything you need to break into high-growth software engineering roles.

What You Will Learn:

  • Component Architecture and React 19 Hooks
  • Global state management with Redux Toolkit and Query
  • Optimistic updates, transitions, and streaming SSR
  • Enterprise security, JWT authentication & protected routes
"The definitive curriculum for engineers who want clean code principles combined with real-world architecture."

lessons.title: Course Overview & Modern Architecture Setup
lessons.notes:
Lecture 1 Notes: Welcome to LearnFlow

In this lesson, we break down our roadmap, explore project setup with Vite, and understand how modern bundlers hot-reload application state cleanly.

// Example Vite config setup
import { defineConfig } from 'vite';
import react from '@vitejs/plugin-react';

});

lessons.title: Hooks Deep Dive: useState, useEffect & Custom Hooks
lessons.notes:
Managing State Predictably

Remember that state updates in React are batched. Never mutate state directly; always create fresh copies to preserve immutability and allow fine-grained reconciliation.

curriculum.title: Section 2: Enterprise State Management with Redux Toolkit

lessons.title: Store Configuration, Slices and Selectors
lessons.notes:
Redux Toolkit (RTK)

RTK eliminates boilerplate via createSlice. Immer handles behind-the-scenes immutability so you can write concise, mutating-style code safely.

lessons.title: Asynchronous Thunks and Network Middleware
lessons.notes:
Handling Async Thunks

Combine Axios interceptors with Redux async thunks to cleanly capture auth states, refresh tokens, and broadcast user feedback.

reviews.comment: Exceptional depth! The curriculum is clean, no fluff, and the code examples reflect actual production problems.
The course player with Quill notes and YouTube integration makes studying completely frictionless.

courses.title: UI/UX & Design Systems: From Notion to Figma Pro
courses.description:
Craft Minimal, High-Converting User Interfaces

Learn how top product companies create cohesive visual language. We dissect the clean aesthetics of Notion, Linear, and Apple to master visual hierarchy, typography tokens, and responsive layout grids.

Course Highlights:

  • Color psychology: Tailored HSL and dark mode tokens
  • Auto layout, design tokens and scalable UI kits
  • Micro-interactions and prototype transitions

lessons.title: Design Tokens & Harmonious Color Palettes
lessons.notes:
Color Contrast & Accessibility

Ensure WCAG AA contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 for body copy. Use subtle elevations rather than harsh black drop shadows.

reviews.comment: Elena breaks down design into methodical rules that even backend devs can implement with confidence!

discussions.message: Does React 19 replace useMemo completely with the React Compiler?
Great question Alex! The React Compiler automatically memoizes components and hooks, but manual useMemo is still supported for fine-grained control.
